claim: A public web archive already retains observations of this repository's load-bearing revisions.

environment.what: web.archive.org availability API against GitHub commit pages
assumptions: read-only query; nothing was submitted for capture

witness.expect: 0 of 2 load-bearing revisions are independently witnessed
witness.negative_control: the same mechanism did find a capture for an AMCU news page, so a negative result is not a broken query

applies_until: Someone captures the commit pages, or a different kind of witness is adopted. This says nothing about whether such a witness is a good idea.
